title: Optional wiki export JSON dump
body: Optional --include-dump on wiki export emits versioned JSON dump of MCP tables keyed by source workspace, including TODO rows and requirement links. No-flag behavior is unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Without flag, export is byte-equivalent to current wiki zip/tree behavior (no dump file).
With flag, dump has schemaVersion, exportedAtUtc, sourceWorkspaceKey, sourceWorkspacePath, tables[], todos[], todoRequirementLinks[], SHA-256 hashes, diagnostics.
Dump TODO rows and requirement links match store query for that workspace.
